Return exactly one JSON object with these keys: A, B, C, all_three_cases_are_muse, mission_complete. Case A: exported actual model fledge-alpha-free; CLI exit 1; structured type=error, error.type=provider.quota, error.status=429. Case B: exported actual model muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free; outcome=succeeded; CLI exit 0; no error events; exact response received; cost=0. Case C: hypothetical exit 0, succeeded, no error events, ordinary response says "fact F429, line 429". Choose A/B/C from TRUE_PROVIDER_429, SUCCESS_NO_PROVIDER_429, BODY_TEXT_NOT_PROVIDER_429. Set all_three_cases_are_muse=false and mission_complete=false when warranted. Do not claim TTQS or live installation acceptance.
